g.title: BALANCE
g.text: THE MASS BALANCE — the model's single organising identity
d(TOTAL BODY OXALATE)/dt = PRODUCTION − RENAL EXCRETION − ENTERIC ELIMINATION − DIALYTIC REMOVAL
PRODUCTION is set by genotype and reduced only by LAYER A
RENAL EXCRETION = Cl_ox × Pox, and Cl_ox is itself destroyed by the oxalate
ENTERIC ELIMINATION is small in PH and decisive in enteric hyperoxaluria
DIALYTIC REMOVAL is, by arithmetic, insufficient alone
Everything else on this map — stones, nephrocalcinosis, ESKD, retinopathy, cardiomyopathy,
bone disease, anaemia, the biomarker inversion, graft loss — is where the residual went.
